input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data export clause
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit provision, so we would lose our Site content and customer data on termination. We have added a short clause giving us at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days after expiry or termination, which is our fallback position.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) provide the Company with transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and (b) export and deliver to the Company all Content, user information and other data of the Company within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.
